decision: POLYSOLVER receives an HLA-region plus unmapped extract instead of the full alignment
kind: method change discovered through operational need, not prespecified

problem.summary: POLYSOLVER sorts its input twice and exhausted the project allocation.
problem.detail: The module ran `samtools sort -n`, `fixmate`, then `samtools sort` on the whole 10.4 GB exome BAM. One sample produced a 35 GB work directory with 110 sort chunks and filled the 250 GiB allocation to 0 bytes free. Its bundled samtools then segfaulted reading back temp files that had been truncated mid-write.

change.before: POLYSOLVER input = full alignment produced by CRAM_TO_BAM
change.after: POLYSOLVER input = chr6 MHC window merged with unmapped reads
change.implementation: workflow/modules/polysolver.nf, mirroring the extraction HLAHD_BAM already performs

unmapped_reads_retained.why: POLYSOLVER uses unmapped reads to recover HLA reads that failed to map to the reference. Excluding them would change which alleles it can call, making this a larger method change than necessary. Including them keeps the change as small as the storage constraint allows.

comparability_caveat.statement: This changes what the caller sees, so it is a method change and not only a storage fix.
comparability_caveat.affected_historical_result: The frozen registry records POLYSOLVER at 357/390 on WES. That number was produced from full-alignment input.
comparability_caveat.consequence: POLYSOLVER results produced after this change are not directly comparable with that figure. Any comparison across the boundary must say which input each side used.
comparability_caveat.required_before_claiming: If a corrected run reports POLYSOLVER accuracy, the manuscript must state that its input differs from the historical configuration, or re-run the historical configuration for a matched comparison.

discovery_path: Found by running the pipeline, not by prespecification: the allocation filled and POLYSOLVER segfaulted on truncated sort chunks. Disclosed here rather than folded into a commit message, per CLAUDE.md.
authorised_by: author, 2026-09-13, in response to the measured storage exhaustion

alternatives_rejected.more_quota: Author chose batched execution within the existing allocation instead.
alternatives_rejected.region_only_without_unmapped: Smaller still, but drops reads POLYSOLVER is designed to use; rejected as a larger method change.
alternatives_rejected.reduce_the_reserve: The 100 GiB reserve is kept; base usage is reclaimed instead.
